bio: Sadia works at Pathao as a backend developer. She specializes in Node.js and microservices architecture. During university, she led the BUET Coding Club and interned at SELISE Digital Platforms.
Rakib is a Financial Analyst at BRAC Bank. He completed his CFA Level 2 and previously interned at Standard Chartered Bank. He advises students to focus on financial modeling and Excel skills.
Tania works at icddr,b as a Research Associate in the Infectious Diseases division. She has co-authored 3 research papers and is pursuing her Master's in Public Health.
Mehedi manages infrastructure projects at Rangs Properties Ltd. He has overseen 5 major residential projects in Dhaka and specializes in project planning and cost estimation.
Nusrat works at Unilever Bangladesh as a Brand Executive. She manages the Lifebuoy brand and has led successful digital campaigns reaching millions of customers.
Arif is a Frontend Developer at Shohoz. He is passionate about React and building user-friendly interfaces. He also mentors students at his former university.
Farzana leads content strategy at The Daily Star's digital wing. She creates engaging content for social media and has grown their Instagram following to 500k.
Shahid is a Management Trainee at Grameenphone. He is rotating through different departments including sales, marketing, and operations as part of the MT program.
Moumita works at LGED as a Junior Engineer. She has worked on rural road development projects in 3 districts and is passionate about sustainable infrastructure.
Imran works at Square Pharmaceuticals in quality control. He ensures products meet GMP standards and has contributed to 3 successful product launches.
